description.value: Rice and Noodle is a BC-based fast-casual Southeast Asian chain that has operated since 2010, specializing in cooked-to-order dishes like pad thai, curries, and noodle bowls with customizable protein and spice levels. The Lonsdale Avenue location sits in a busy North Vancouver corridor and offers dine-in, takeout, and third-party delivery. It is part of a growing franchise with multiple Lower Mainland locations.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (3 spaces) at 5m; stands (3 spaces) at 22m; rack (3 spaces) at 27m; stands (3 spaces) at 43m; stands (3 spaces) at 50m; wave (5 spaces) at 55m. Total: 20 spaces.
